message: Vector Rebel 3.2.75: date-scoped temporary Captain Set members correct false historical misses without changing native Vector PPE receipts.
releaseNotes: In Settings > Captain Sets > Edit, a captain can define first and last C-shift tour start dates for a temporary multi-tour crew assignment. A temporary member stays available in the Captain Set during those tours but prior/subsequent tours are blank, not fabricated PPE misses, OFF or unknown. Confirmed native completed inspections remain green in the historical report. Within the chosen tour range, real any-unit attendance and PPE inspection duty rules remain unchanged. The saved read-only Daily Captain report automatically recalculates from its existing native Item Log snapshot after assignment dates are corrected, without another inspection-history scan or changing the original scan timestamp. Temporary swings added through + Add Swing still apply only to the chosen day(s); permanent members remain unchanged. SCBA submission authorization and receipt safeguards remain unchanged; in-progress SCBA queues from 3.2.74 and older supported versions remain compatible. This release does not claim to alter any actual Vector inspection, change CrewSense staffing, or certify an SCBA.
